title: In case of + noun
titleZh: 「In case of + noun」表示「如遇／若發生」
titleEn: Using In case of + noun for a possible situation

source.file: Sentence Structure 178 -「In case of + noun」表示「如遇／若發生」.pdf
omissions: English versions of Chinese-only Important Rules are faithful editorial translations.

formula: In case of + noun / noun phrase, + main clause

formulas.formula: In case of + noun / noun phrase, + main clause
Main clause + in case of + noun / noun phrase

example: In case of emergency, press this button immediately.
exampleZh: 如遇緊急情況，請立即按下這個按鈕。

examples.en: In case of emergency, press this button immediately.
examples.zh: 如遇緊急情況，請立即按下這個按鈕。
examples.highlight: In case of emergency, press this button immediately.

rules.zh: Of 後面須使用名詞或名詞詞組，不能直接接完整句子。 錯誤：In case of it rains, stay indoors. 正確：In case of rain, stay indoors.
rules.en: Use a noun after of Of If it rains → in case of rain If the power fails → in case of power failure If the road is closed → in case of a road closure If the temperature drops → in case of a drop in temperature Incorrect: In case of it rains, stay indoors. Correct: In case of rain, stay indoors.
examples: If it rains → in case of rain
If the power fails → in case of power failure
If the road is closed → in case of a road closure
If the temperature drops → in case of a drop in temperature
Incorrect: In case of it rains, stay indoors.

rules.zh: 改寫時，有些動詞或形容詞需要轉換成名詞。
rules.en: Some verbs or adjectives must be changed into nouns fail → failure cancel → cancellation close → closure lose → loss interrupt → interruption arrive late → late arrival become ill → illness

rules.zh: 當 In case of... 放在句首時，名詞詞組後通常使用逗號。 放在句末時，通常不需要逗號。
rules.en: Use a comma after a beginning phrase In case of fire, use the stairs. Use the stairs in case of fire.
examples: In case of fire, use the stairs.

rules.zh: 某些一般情況或常見固定說法通常不使用冠詞： 可數的個別事件通常需要 a 或 an：
rules.en: Check whether an article is needed in case of fire in case of emergency in case of rain in case of illness in case of delay in case of an accident in case of a power cut in case of a gas leak in case of a serious allergic reaction
examples: in case of a power cut
in case of a gas leak
in case of a serious allergic reaction

rules.zh: 這個句型帶有簡潔、程序化的語氣，常見於： safety instructions 安全指示 public notices 公共告示 workplace procedures 工作程序 school rules 學校規則 emergency plans 緊急應變計劃 customer-service information 顧客服務資訊
rules.en: This pattern has a concise, procedural tone and is especially common in safety instructions, public notices, workplace procedures, school rules, emergency plans and customer-service information.

rules.zh: In case of + noun 通常表示某情況發生時應採取的行動。 （如下雨，比賽將移到室內舉行。） In case + clause 經常表示預先作好準備，以防某事發生。 （帶一把雨傘，以防下雨。）
rules.en: Do not confuse in case of + noun with in case + clause. In case of + noun normally introduces the action to take when a situation occurs: In case of rain, the match will be moved indoors. In case + clause often describes advance preparation against a possible event: Take an umbrella in case it rains.
examples: Do not confuse it with in case + clause
In case of rain, the match will be moved indoors.

rules.zh: In the case of + noun 通常表示「就某人或某件事而言」，並非「如遇某情況」。 （就年幼兒童而言，額外看管是有必要的。）
rules.en: Do not confuse it with in the case of In the case of + noun In the case of younger children, extra supervision is necessary.
examples: In the case of younger children, extra supervision is necessary.

benefits.zh: 這個句型能清楚說明在甚麼情況下，某項指示、規則或安排才會適用。
benefits.en: It states the condition clearly This structure tells the reader exactly which situation will cause an instruction, rule or arrangement to apply.

benefits.zh: 你不需要反覆使用 if there is... 或 if something happens... 等較長結構，也可以直接表達相關 條件。 第二句較簡潔，讀者也能立即掌握重要情況。
benefits.en: It can shorten a longer if-clause Instead of repeatedly writing if there is... or if something happens..., you can express the condition more directly. Compare: If there is a fire, use the stairs. In case of fire, use the stairs.
examples: If there is a fire, use the stairs.
In case of fire, use the stairs.

benefits.zh: 這個句型非常適合用來表達安全指示、緊急程序、學校規則及工作指引。
benefits.en: It is useful for practical instructions You can use it when giving safety instructions, emergency procedures, school rules or workplace directions.

benefits.zh: 把 In case of... 放在句首，可以先突出需要注意的情況，再說明應採取的行動。
benefits.en: It can place the important situation first Beginning with In case of... draws attention to the possible problem before explaining the required action.

benefits.zh: 適當使用這個句型，可以避免指示或較正式的文章中有太多句子都以 if 開始，使句式更有變化。
benefits.en: It gives you an alternative to repeated if-sentences Using this structure occasionally helps your instructions and formal writing avoid too many sentences beginning with if.
